title: ProductIdeasFromPaper
description: Extract product implementation ideas grounded in research paper findings.

paper_summary.description: Brief context about the paper - enough to ground the product ideas.

core_problem.description: What problem does the paper solve?

key_solution.description: What approach/technique does the paper propose?

proven_results.description: What did the paper actually demonstrate or validate?

product_implementation_ideas.description: Product or feature ideas derived from the paper's findings, with grounding evidence.

idea_name.description: Concise name for the product/feature idea.

description.description: Brief description of what the product does.

target_users.description: Who would use this product (persona, industry, use case).

grounding_in_paper.description: Specific evidence from the paper that supports this idea (cited findings, proven mechanisms, validated approaches).

implementation_roadmap.description: Key implementation steps, ordered by priority. Reference specific techniques/algorithms from the paper where applicable.

technical_requirements.description: Key technical components needed (e.g., 'Transformer encoder', 'Vector database', 'Real-time inference pipeline').

complexity.description: Implementation complexity based on paper's technical depth.

data_requirements.description: Data needs as inferred from the paper's methodology.

computational_cost.description: Compute requirements based on paper's resource analysis.

risk_factors.description: Potential risks or limitations cited in the paper.

unfair_advantage.description: What unique edge this idea has based on the paper's novel contributions vs. existing solutions.

validation_strategy.description: How to validate this idea, referencing the paper's evaluation methodology.
